workflow: Multiple threads concurrently read and replace mutable metadata fields of the same shared callable object.
A writer updates field pointers and related ownership state without synchronization, sometimes clearing a related field during replacement.
A reader observes or uses the metadata while the replacement and release are in progress, seeing inconsistent state or invalid object lifetime.
Race detection reports the conflicting access, and concurrent execution may fail instead of completing safely.
summary: Concurrent unsynchronized replacement and reading of shared callable metadata
decision_reason: The bug is materially the same as concurrent replacement and reading of shared object state: writers replace shared pointer-valued fields while readers access them without sufficient synchronization. The callable-specific attributes and execution metadata are implementation details that do not alter
